proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition variant in spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Faerie Fire's save gate on fail applies the 'outlined' state — a persistent marker that carries the advantage rider and invisible-negation for the concentration duration. The Effect union for spell activation phases only supports DamageEffect and NoneEffect. Mastery phases already have apply_condition in SaveGateRiderResult; the same variant is needed for spell activation phase effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage_against as OngoingOperation (or spell Effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: The core combat payload of Faerie Fire is that attack rolls made BY OTHERS against the outlined target have Advantage. No existing OngoingOperation variant captures this direction: roll_modifier applies a delta to the marked creature's own rolls; damage_on_hit fires when the caster hits the attachment. A new variant is needed for 'third-party attack rolls against this target gain advantage'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

proposed_widenings.name: block_condition_benefit effect variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Faerie Fire suppresses the benefit of the Invisible condition for outlined targets. This is distinct from remove_condition (Invisible is not removed, just made ineffective) and from any current Effect, ReactionEffect, or ClassFeatureEffect variant. The v4 atom block_targeting is in the taxonomy but is not surfaced in types.ts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: objects and affected creatures ... can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition enum extension — 'outlined' (or equivalent marker)
proposed_widenings.justification: The 'outlined' persistent marker applied by the save gate is the intermediate state that both the advantage rider and the invisible-negation attach to. Condition currently only contains 'prone'. Either 'outlined' must be added, or a more general mechanism for spell-applied persistent states is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures...

proposed_widenings.name: Mixed-targeting area attachment: objects auto-affected, creatures must save
proposed_widenings.justification: Faerie Fire affects all objects in the Cube automatically but requires each creature to fail a save. No existing Attachment or ActivationPhase shape models a split where non-creature targets skip the save gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined... Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw.

notes: The spell kind (spell) and concentration pattern fit the existing framework. The activation family with a save_gate phase handles the initial creature filtering; extending Effect with apply_condition would let the outlined state be expressed. The deeper gap is encoding the *ongoing* effects of that state (advantage on attackers, invisible-negation) — neither OngoingOperation nor any spell Effect variant covers these. This 'save gate → apply persistent marker → downstream ongoing modifiers' pattern is a recurring one (Hold Person, Entangle, Hypnotic Pattern all share it) and the widening would benefit the whole class. Objects being auto-affected with no save is a secondary gap noted but not the blocking issue.
